name: Building Engines
positioning: Prism, the building operations platform property teams at JLL, CBRE and Hines use to run work orders and tenant compliance.
description: Building Engines, a JLL company, publishes Prism, a building operations platform for commercial real estate covering work orders, bid management, preventive maintenance, tenant insurance compliance, inspections and incident tracking, alongside a tenant-facing module for resource reservations and visitor access.
real_estate_use: A building engineer dispatches and closes out work orders through Prism instead of a spreadsheet, and the same platform tracks whether every tenant's certificate of insurance is current before a compliance deadline. On the tenant side, an occupant books a shared conference room or registers a visitor through Prism's tenant experience module rather than emailing the front desk.
features: Tenant resource reservations and visitor access

use_cases.job: Dispatch and close out work orders and track preventive maintenance across a portfolio
Track tenant certificate-of-insurance compliance ahead of deadlines
